description: Double-clicking a Save button bound to an action sends the action once and saves one record, and the button and form are busy while it is in flight

browserSteps.value: Count every send of the action from the page

(() => { window.__supplierSends = 0; const send = window.fetch; window.fetch = (...args) => { if (String(args[0]).includes('/_piko/actions/suppliers.Create')) { window.__supplierSends++; } return send(...args); }; return true; })()
Wait for the save to settle, then check that it was sent once

new Promise((resolve, reject) => { const deadline = performance.now() + 10000; const poll = () => { if (!document.querySelector('#supplier').hasAttribute('aria-busy') && !document.querySelector('#save-supplier').hasAttribute('aria-busy')) { resolve(true); return; } if (performance.now() > deadline) { reject(new Error('the save never settled')); return; } setTimeout(poll, 20); }; poll(); }).then(() => { if (window.__supplierSends !== 1) { throw new Error('the action was sent ' + window.__supplierSends + ' times'); } return true; })
